title: System Architecture, Distributed Concurrency Patterns, and NFRs
acceptance_criteria: High-level architecture script using Python diagrams library saved in scripts/generate_architecture_diagram.py.
C4 / Container architecture diagram embedded in docs/Ediens_SRS/04-architecture.md.
5 distributed concurrency patterns documented in 06-concurrency-patterns.md using both Mermaid sequenceDiagram and WebSequenceDiagrams compatible blocks.
Detailed explanation of ETag/xmin, Redis distributed lock with idempotency, transactional outbox with SKIP LOCKED, pessimistic row locking for macro budgets, and HybridCache singleflight.
At least 6 Non-Functional Requirements documented across chapters 08–12 (Resiliency, Security, Deployment, Analytics, Monitoring).
